author: D4n1el_f77
quote: This is an absolutely disappointing experience from start to finish. Nothing about it manages to deliver a satisfying or worthwhile experience. The execution is poor, the overall quality is unacceptable, and it fails to meet even the most basic expectations.There is little to appreciate, as the flaws overshadow everything else. It feels unfinished, poorly thought out, and lacking any meaningful effort to create something engaging or enjoyable. Rather than offering a reason to keep going, it constantly gives reasons to lose **** fails on nearly every level and offers no redeeming qualities that could justify a positive impression. An experience this frustrating and disappointing is hard to overlook.Verdict: A complete failure. 0/100.
